# Francesco Cirillo

> Academic website and open research archive of Francesco Cirillo, legal scholar working on legal theory, constitutional law, digital regulation and neurolaw.

## Research areas

- [Legal Theory and Method](https://francescocirillo.eu/ricerca/legal-theory.html): legal theory and legal doctrine, legal reasoning, judicial decision-making and the history of legal thought.
- [Digital Regulation](https://francescocirillo.eu/ricerca/digital-regulation.html): artificial intelligence, fundamental rights, proportionality and evidence-based regulation.
- [Neurolaw and Cognitive Liberty](https://francescocirillo.eu/ricerca/neurolaw.html): neuroprivacy, neurorights, cognitive liberty and cognitive manipulation.
- [Constitutional Transformations](https://francescocirillo.eu/ricerca/constitutional-transformations.html): new rights, future generations, end of life and constitutional change.

- [Scuola Estiva Arpinate](https://sites.google.com/view/sea-arpino): scientific and organising secretariat; School website creation and management. Scientific director: Enrico Ferri.
